program:
:- prefix(ex, 'https://example.org/1428/').
ex:ans(X, D) :- X is 0, A is 1/2, B is 1/3, D is A + B.
?- ex:ans(X, D).

provenance.derivation: 1/2 + 1/3: common denominator 6 -> 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6 (already in lowest terms, gcd(5,6)=1). `X` is an unused dummy arg (`X is 0`) so the goal atom is arity >= 2, keeping the query on the binary backward path -- see the corpus README's arity note.
provenance.note: independently derived; never hand-edited to match the native engine
